accounting.ebitdaBasis: Company 'operating EBITDA' excludes other income and (from Q1FY27) ESOP cost; Screener's operating profit = revenue − expenses, i.e. company operating EBITDA less ESOP. Post-Ind AS 116: lease rentals sit in depreciation (₹85 cr of right-of-use amortisation) and interest (₹41 cr); ₹85 cr of short-term lease rent stays in operating cost.
accounting.minorities: Screener's consolidated 'Net Profit' is before minorities (FY26 ₹1,064 cr) while EPS (₹13.80) is after them (₹1,042 cr); FORTIS.patch.js puts profit on the attributable basis so implied shares = 75.5 cr (actual 75,49,56,000-odd).
accounting.exceptionals: FY25 −₹89 cr (associate and asset impairments, partly offset by the Richmond Road gain); FY26 −₹22 cr (Labour Codes charge ₹55 cr less impairment reversal ₹33 cr); Q1FY27 +₹9.5 cr (impairment reversal at an associate). Screener books these in other income.
accounting.goodwill: Goodwill ₹4,722 cr (Mar-2026), ~35% of capital employed: from the RHT buyback, Agilus/SRL and FY26 acquisitions; tested annually (key audit matter)
accounting.receivables: Debtor days 33 (FY24) → 42 (FY26); doubtful-debt provisions rose in Q1FY27 on slow government and TPA collections
accounting.tax: Effective tax rate 22.1% in FY26 (Q4FY26 16%), 24.9% in Q1FY27
